name: fretforge
description: Self-hosted tab player, library and practice tool

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fretforge/web && npm run build -w @fretforge/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @fretforge/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/desktop
